import gzip, math
import numpy as np
path='sample.swap.atac.q1.tsv.gz'
with gzip.open(path,'rt') as f:
    header=f.readline().rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    samples=header[3:]
    sums=np.zeros(len(samples),dtype=np.float64); n=0
    # First pass sums already? recompute
    for line in f:
        vals=np.fromstring(line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t',3)[3],sep='\\t',dtype=np.float64)
        sums+=vals; n+=1
median=np.median(sums)
# streaming cov of log CPM-ish
m=len(samples)
mean=np.zeros(m); M2=np.zeros((m,m)); n2=0
# store maybe top variable subset? no
with gzip.open(path,'rt') as f:
    f.readline()
    for line in f:
        vals=np.fromstring(line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t',3)[3],sep='\\t',dtype=np.float64)
        x=np.log1p(vals/sums*median)
        n2+=1
        delta=x-mean
        mean += delta/n2
        M2 += np.outer(delta, x-mean)
cov=M2/(n2-1)
sd=np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
corr=cov/np.outer(sd,sd)
print('samples', '\\t'.join(samples))
print('pairwise top correlations')
pairs=[]
for i in range(m):
    for j in range(i+1,m):
        pairs.append((corr[i,j],samples[i],samples[j]))
for r,a,b in sorted(pairs, reverse=True)[:30]: print(f'{a}\\t{b}\\t{r:.4f}')
print('lowest')
for r,a,b in sorted(pairs)[:20]: print(f'{a}\\t{b}\\t{r:.4f}')
# nearest neighbor each
print('nearest')
for i,s in enumerate(samples):
    j=max([j for j in range(m) if j"'!=i], key=lambda j:corr[i,j])
    print(s, samples[j], corr[i,j])

from collections import defaultdict

with open('sample.swap.atac.q1.chrom.sizes') as f:

offsets={}
for base,lst in chunks_by_base.items():

# parse genes: human symbol [hs]
attr_re=re.compile(r'(\\S+) \"(["'^"]*)"'"')

with gzip.open('data/AmexT_v47-AmexG_v6.0-DD.gtf.gz','rt') as f:

        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(parts)<9 or parts[2] "'!= '"'gene': continue
        chrom,_,_,start,end,_,strand,_,attr=parts
        start=int(start); end=int(end)
        attrs=dict(attr_re.findall(attr))
        gname=attrs.get('gene_name',attrs.get('gene_id',''))
        m=re.search(r'([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+) \\[hs\\]', gname)

        nr=None

print('genes',len(genes),'hs',sum(1 for g in genes if g[7]))
# create marker gene list
markers={

'Cloaca':['KRT13','TP63','EPCAM','KRT8','KRT18','MUC2','KRT5']
}
allm=sorted(set(x for v in markers.values() for x in v))

sel=[g for g in genes if g[7] in allm]
print('selected records',len(sel),'unique',len(set(g[7] for g in sel)))
print('missing markers')
for tissue,ms in markers.items():
    found=sorted(set(g[7] for g in sel if g[7] in ms))
    miss=[m for m in ms if m not in found]
    if miss: print(tissue,'missing',miss)
# Save gene promoter intervals ±50kb mapped to chunks
promoters=[]
for chrom,start,end,strand,tss,gid,gname,hs,nr in sel:

    # Map interval tss +/-50kb to chunk coords, maybe split over chunks
    lo=max(1,tss-50000); hi=tss+50000

    for rec in bychunk[chunk]:

        vals=[activity[gene][i]/libs[i]*1e6 for i in range(len(samples))]
        f.write(gene+'\\t'+str(hits[gene])+'\\t'+'\\t'.join(f'{x:.3f}' for x in vals)+'\\n')
print('wrote',out,'genes',len(activity))
# marker tissue average z/ranks
# load into dict
act={g:activity[g] for g in activity}
import numpy as np
libs=np.array(libs,float)
# log norm per gene
scores=[]
for tissue,ms in markers.items():
    present=[m for m in ms if m in act]
    if not present: continue
    mat=[]
    for m in present:
        v=np.array(act[m],float)/libs*1e6
        x=np.log1p(v)
        # z across samples per gene
        if x.std()>0: x=(x-x.mean())/x.std()
        mat.append(x)
    sc=np.vstack(mat).mean(axis=0)
    order=sorted(zip(sc,samples), reverse=True)
    scores.append((tissue,present,order))
    print('\\nMARKER',tissue,'present',present)
    for val,s in order[:8]: print(f'{s}:{val:.2f}',end=' ')
    print()
